text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I-I ran it all...! I danced it all!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Thank youuu... ngh. *collapses*...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"I-I'm okay... I just felt so relieved all 
my strength drained away...~"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Looks like my shoulders were way too 
tense. Can't really help it, though.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's passion was just so incredible, 
you know...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—Every step I take drains my strength, 
which is why the more I run, the more 
desperate I become.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Gritting your teeth until you're 
completely worn down... and waiting for 
you after the race is—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The Winning Live! Whipping her exhausted 
body into gear, she sings with all her 
might to answer everyone who cheered for 
her—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"UNLIMITED IMPACT"! A genuine, 
wholehearted performance...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
When it was all over, some girls couldn't 
even stand. That's what the dirt track is 
like...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —That's why Falco loves the dirt!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's so full-throttle and passionately 
blazing that my heart trembles... Everyone 
is crying out, 'Listen to my voice!'

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco wants so many people to see dirt 
races... to see my stage!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Just like back at the Satsuki Sho! I'm 
gonna bring that packed, electrifying 
stage to the dirt track!

"Rediscovering the appeal of dirt racing 
seems to have lit a fire in Smart Falcon's 
heart. Then it's only natural that her 
next race will also be—"
choice_data_list: Let's run the GⅠ just like this.

text_block_list.text:
If she keeps running in high-profile 
races, her fanbase will surely grow. The 
competition will be fierce, but she's 
bound to overcome it!
choice_data_list: I'm gonna stand at the top of dirt racing!
I'll stand at the top of dirt racing!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"If Falco reaches the top... I'm sure 
everyone all around the world will pay 
attention to me♪"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"A top dirt Umadol destined for the 
history books! I can't wait~♪"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So, what should I run after the Japan Dirt 
Derby?

With a distance close to the Japan Dirt 
Derby, and a chance to compete against 
Senior Class Umamusume, this race is 
perfect to prove her strength.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Mmm, "Classic" has such a nice ring to it☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Okey-doke! Falco's gonna do her best♪

And so, the next target race was decided: 
the JBC Classic.
